{"action":"done","summary":"All tests pass (250 total: 4 acceptance_public + 27 new batch writer tests + 219 upstream tests). The existing tinydb/journal.py BatchWriter implementation correctly satisfies all requirements R01-R08:

- R01: apply() accepts operations list with insert/remove ops, returns inserted IDs, raises ValueError on unknown/malformed ops
- R02: Batch application is atomic with full rollback on error (e.g., missing doc_id)
- R03: Deep copies prevent aliasing; mutations to input docs don't affect database
- R04: Rejects bool as doc_id, validates operations structurally (non-list ops, non-dict documents, unsupported fields), accepts empty dicts
- R05: preview() returns IDs without consuming them or modifying data, failed previews don't consume IDs
- R06: Direct db.insert calls between batch operations are visible (no stale snapshot caching)
- R07: Idempotent apply() with token - same ops return cached IDs, different ops raise ValueError, failed batches don't consume tokens
- R08: Token bookkeeping stays in BatchWriter instance, never in user documents; preview doesn't consume tokens; returned lists are detached copies

No changes to source were needed - the implementation was already correct."}
